summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly open-market share repurchases under a buyback programme announced 20 May 2025. During 20-24 April 2026, it bought 10,000 ordinary shares at an average of ~€24.10 and 574,716 ADS-equivalent shares at ~$29.39 per ADS. All purchased shares will be cancelled, reducing shares outstanding. The programme is conducted under EU Market Abuse Regulation Article 5(1)(b). As an open-market buyback, no fixed price, premium, or tender mechanism applies. What to watch: execution pace vs. programme authorization and impact on EPS/dilution; risk-arb not applicable since it is not a fixed-price issuer tender.
